paragraphs.text: Morgane, the Great Druid was a druid on Shandalar , who took command of the Green Guild until its downfall.

Morgane's forces included druids , enchantresses , elvishmagi , forest dragons , beastmasters , summoners , ape lords , tusk guardians , centaur shamans , fungus masters , Alt-A-Kesh djinni and Prismat dragons .

The guildlords and the guilds themselves were originally of pure intent to defend Shandalar but were corrupted by the evil Planeswalker Arzakon 's influence in the guise of a benevolent advisor. Together, they betrayed the Guardian of Shandalar during Arzakon's War , to open the path for Arzakon.
The Guildlords, including Morgane, were in turn defeated, and Arzakon was banned from entering the plane.
